title: Revision picker
responsibility: Shows the selected branch, commit or environment with its update time and opens revision choices.

inputs.name: RevisionPicker.workspace
inputs.description: Workspace supplying snapshot, revision, branch/commit lists, pinned state and navigation. Values follow the displayed revision. Branch navigation supplies only branch; commit navigation includes both.

outputs.name: RevisionPicker
outputs.description: One summary line names the branch or explicit short commit hash with its timestamp. For an environment scope, it reads Updated at and the deployment date and time; the selector already names the environment. Icon dialogs select revisions and Go to tip exits a pinned revision.

dependencies.contract: The shared Select component supplies keyboard and value selection behavior through the $shared alias.
